fields.climate: tropical; moderated by northeast trade winds
fields.terrain: flat and low-lying island of coral and limestone
fields.hazards: frequent hurricanes and other tropical storms (July to October)
fields.farm: small quantities of tobacco, vegetables; cattle raising
fields.exports: packaged medicine, garments, vehicle parts/accessories, vaccines, cars
fields.industries: tourism, boat building, offshore financial services
fields.religions: Protestant 73.2% (includes Anglican 22.7%, Methodist 19.4%, Pentecostal 10.5%, Seventh Day Adventist 8.3%, Baptist 7.1%, Church of God 4.9%, Presbyterian 0.2%, Brethren 0.1%), Roman Catholic 6.8%…

system.text: parliamentary democracy (House of Assembly); self-governing overseas territory of the UK

fields.legal: common law based on the English model
